text:
Type: pleated fabric shade wall lamp
Use: reading or soft light beside a bed or a sofa; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: traditional, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: white pleated fabric shade, nickel-plated metal arm and wall plate, metal pull chain, white cord
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: tapered pleated drum shade hanging from a curved swan-neck arm, round stepped backplate, pull chain switch, compact and light
Feel: soft, cozy, homely, elegant
Goes with: white or pastel walls, upholstered headboards, nickel accents; traditional, classic or Scandinavian bedrooms

product.name: RSTID
product.description: You can create a soft, cosy atmosphere in your home with a textile shade that spreads a diffused and decorative light.
